content:
**Fried Radtoad Legs** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

These are the legs of a Radtoad that have been fried to improve its taste and nutritional value.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Pepper (2) Radtoad Leg (2) Razorgrain (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Fried Radtoad Legs | | Fried Radtoad Legs (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after the Recipe has been learned.
